purpose: Exploratory second analysis motivated by large input-column mode-Gram offdiagonals in the first analysis. Not preregistered before viewing first analysis; no receiver or network run.

bases.block_gram: Eigenvectors V_k of A_k^H A_k; analysis coordinates V_k^H x_k.
bases.row_preconditioned: Eigenvectors V_k of A_k^H (A A^H)^(-1) A_k; fixed within case, computed exclusively from public A.

limitations: Both bases are candidates suggested by geometry. Numerical results on reused evaluation scenes are exploratory, not an independent basis-selection validation.
Uncentered single-query mode Gram, not an identified conditional covariance.
The basis depends on public A and user k, not on query, truth, or iteration. A new A can yield a different basis; network must know resulting C or its noise realizations.
A diagonal marginal mode Gram does not establish Gaussianity, signal independence, or full tensor covariance separability.
